attchmntText: Alembic Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Alembic Limited published an advertisement regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement appeared in the Indian Express English Edition and Financial Express Gujarati Edition on 7th November 2026. The publication includes a Quick Response Code and a weblink to the company website for complete financial details. The company requested the stock exchanges to take this on record.

attchmntText: Alembic Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
